```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

Cell Hashing: tagged antibodies against ubiquitous cell surface proteins to multiplex samples
CITE-seq: cell-surface protein measurements

# Create Seurat object

## Read h5 file name from command line argument (for Rscript execution)
```{r}
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) > 0) {
  h5_file <- args[1]
} else {
  h5_file <- "path/to/your_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5" # fallback for interactive use
}
print(paste("Using input file:", h5_file))
```

## Load data from h5 file
```{r}
sample.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file)

// Assumes these have already been filtered to shared barcodes

rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_[control_]*TotalSeqB", replacement = "",
    rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
    
# Split into RNA and ADT matrices
rna_counts <- sample.data[["Gene Expression"]]
adt_counts <- sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]
```

## Create Seurat object with RNA and normalize
```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts) # Can filter: min.cells = 3, min.features = 200
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
```

## Add CITE-seq data and normalize (CLR transformation)
```{r}
seurat_obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(adt_counts[, colnames(seurat_obj)])
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
```

## Add HTO data and normalize 
```{r}
seurat_obj[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = hto_counts)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
```

# Demultiplex samples by HTO
Performs clustering on normalized values to separate cells into K(number of samples)+1 clusters. 
For each HTO, classify each cell as positive/negative (doublets positive for more than one).

```{r}
seurat_obj <- HTODemux(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.99)
```

## Identify cross-sample doublets and negative/ambiguous cells
```{r}
# Global classification results
table(seurat_obj$HTO_classification.global)

# Number of UMIs for each
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "HTO_classification.global"
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0.1, log = TRUE)
```

## Visualize demultiplexing results

```{r}
# Group cells based on the max HTO signal
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "HTO_maxID"

# Ridge plot for HTO signals
RidgePlot(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", features = rownames(seurat_obj[["HTO"]]), ncol = 2)

# Visualize pairs to confirm mutual exlusivity
FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "hto_HTO-A", feature2 = "hto_HTO-B")

# UMAP colored by HTO classification
seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj))
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:10)
DimPlot(seurat_obj, group.by = "HTO_classification.global")

# tSNE
# Remove negative cells from the object
seurat_obj.subset <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Negative", invert = TRUE)

# Calculate a tSNE embedding of the HTO data
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj.subset) <- "HTO"
seurat_obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset),
    verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset), approx = FALSE)
seurat_obj.subset <- RunTSNE(seurat_obj.subset, dims = 1:8, perplexity = 100)

# By singlet/doublet
DimPlot(seurat_obj.subset)

# By classification
Idents(object) <- 'HTO_classification'
DimPlot(seurat_obj.subset)
```

## Extract singlets

```{r}
seurat_obj.singlet <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Singlet")
```

# GEX clustering

```{r}
# perform visualization and clustering steps
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30)
seurat_obj <- FindClusters(seurat_obj, resolution = 0.8, verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30)
DimPlot(seurat_obj, label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Normalize RNA data with log normalization
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)

# Select the top 1000 most variable features
seurat_obj.singlet <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj.singlet, selection.method = "mean.var.plot")

# Scaling RNA data, we only scale the variable features here for efficiency
seurat_obj.singlet <- ScaleData(seurat_obj.singlet, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj.singlet))

# Run PCA
seurat_obj.singlet <- RunPCA(seurat_obj.singlet, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj.singlet))

# We select the top 10 PCs for clustering and tSNE based on PCElbowPlot
seurat_obj.singlet <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj.singlet, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:10)
seurat_obj.singlet <- FindClusters(seurat_obj.singlet, resolution = 0.6, verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj.singlet <- RunTSNE(seurat_obj.singlet, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:10)

# Projecting singlet identities on TSNE visualization
DimPlot(seurat_obj.singlet, group.by = "HTO_classification")
```

```{r}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "adt_CD19", feature2 = "adt_CD3", pt.size = 1)
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "adt_CD4", feature2 = "adt_CD8a", pt.size = 1)
plot3 <- FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = "adt_CD3", feature2 = "CD3E", pt.size = 1)
(plot1 + plot2 + plot3) & NoLegend()
```
